text: Implemented typed shared FieldSource descriptors/requests/blocks, source-backed Field roots, terminal-only exact support/time reads in LazyFieldRuntime, freshness validation before result-cache hits, typed unavailable/stale/domain/geometry/shape/request errors, and lazy JVM NIfTI partial reader with deterministic FileChannel closure, endian/datatype/scaling support, first-read revision pinning, and byte/window stats. Removed metadata-only Field.external API. Verified git diff --check; spatialJVM 93/93; spatialJS 83/83. NIfTI fixtures cover real little-endian float64 and big-endian scaled int16 layouts, exact 32-byte and 4-byte partial reads, unavailable/stale/geometry failures.
